content: Atmit is a specialized nutritional supplement designed to combat famine in impoverished regions. This creamy and nutrient-dense food originates from Ethiopia and is now widely utilized to provide sustenance to severely malnourished and physically weakened individuals, including both adults and children. The term atmit is derived from the Ethiopian language and translates to thin, nourishing porridge. The composition of atmit includes rolled oats, powdered milk, powdered sugar, and a blend of essential vitamins and minerals. It is formulated to be easily digestible and is rich in both protein and calories, making it particularly suitable for individuals who are unable to consume solid foods due to severe malnutrition. Marta Gabre-Tsadick, who holds the distinction of being the first female Senator of Ethiopia and is also the co-founder of Project Mercy, Inc., played a pivotal role in adapting the atmit recipe for large-scale production in the United States. This adaptation facilitated its shipment to Ethiopia and other African nations. During the famine crisis of 1985 and 1986, Project Mercy successfully delivered 930 tons of atmit to Ethiopia. Relief workers from World Vision utilized this supply to prepare millions of hot, nutrient-rich meals, which significantly contributed to the recovery and strengthening of individuals debilitated by famine. Various charitable and humanitarian organizations have since developed their own formulations of atmit to address specific nutritional needs. For instance, the version produced by The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints in 2005 for distribution in Niger consisted of the following proportions: 50% fine oatmeal flour, 25% nonfat milk, 20% sugar, and 5% vitamins and minerals. In recent years, the distribution of atmit has expanded beyond Africa to include other regions affected by malnutrition and food insecurity. Countries such as Uganda, Sudan, South Africa, Haiti, Gaza, Bangladesh, Indonesia, Sri Lanka, and Niger have benefited from the provision of this life-saving nutritional supplement.
